body: I'd prefer `onlyMethods` or `memberAccess` or `propertyAccess`. That said the initial explanation of the rule just mentions method calls so may be we should exclude member access completely. That would be a breaking change though.
I'm pretty sure this is a bug, the rule even says "chainable call".
Bumping this, since I often face this issue myself.
